subject.title: fix(xai): gate server-side tools to xAI models only

question: Should xAI-billed `code_execution` and `x_search` be hidden unless `activeModel.provider` is `xai`, including when active-model metadata is missing?
rationale: This is both a security/billing boundary improvement and a compatibility-sensitive default change for users who may intentionally combine non-xAI models with xAI-billed tools.

options.title: Accept fail-closed as default
options.body: Require positive xAI active-provider metadata before exposing these tools, after adding factory tests and real behavior proof for xAI, non-xAI, and missing-provider contexts.

options.title: Require explicit cross-provider opt-in
options.body: Keep the safe default hidden, but add a documented opt-in or allowlist for intentional cross-provider use before this PR lands.

options.title: Pause for broader server-side tool policy
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader provider-native/server-side tool direction decides billing visibility, tool opt-in, and provider ownership consistently.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed as default
recommendation.body: Require positive xAI active-provider metadata before exposing these tools, after adding factory tests and real behavior proof for xAI, non-xAI, and missing-provider contexts.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this person to both the xAI plugin entrypoint and the active-model plugin context that controls the proposed boundary.
